reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Firefighting asks a lot: heavy carries, dragging hose, ladders, and stop-and-go bursts of effort in gear. Tell me how many days a week you can train, how long each session runs, and whether you have a full gym or something more basic, and I'll build a program around that.
